title: Notices - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Notices - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The page serves as a notice board for Lady Irwin College, Delhi, listing a wide array of announcements related to admissions, faculty recruitment, student attendance, institutional events, tenders, and administrative matters. Key concepts include admission procedures for undergraduate and postgraduate courses, walk‑in interview schedules for guest faculty across various departments, student attendance and scholarship notifications, and invitations for tenders and quotations for services such as canteen, housekeeping, and renovation works. Historical context is not explicitly provided, but the notices cover the academic year 2026‑27 and reference previous years for continuity. Primary examples from the content include the Admission Notice for Bachelor in Nutrition & Dietetics (Hons.) 2026‑27, the walk‑in interview schedule for guest faculty in the RMDA Department, the annual art festival KALANTAR‑2026, and the International Conference on Learning 2026.
key_points: The page lists a comprehensive set of notices covering admissions, faculty recruitment, student attendance, and institutional events at Lady Irwin College.
Notices include admission procedures for Bachelor of Nutrition & Dietetics (Hons.) and postgraduate programs, as well as walk‑in interview schedules for guest faculty across multiple departments.
Student-related notices address attendance thresholds, hostel admission, orientation programmes, and scholarship awards for the 2025‑26 academic year.
The college also publishes tenders for services such as canteen, housekeeping, and renovation works, with invitations for quotations from contractors.
Event notices highlight the annual art festival KALANTAR‑2026, the International Conference on Learning, and the College Founder’s Day celebrations.
Administrative announcements cover staff recruitment, clearance forms, and guidelines for multiple entry and exit schemes for undergraduate programmes.
